_doc: Phase 6: rules for building the clinic's own normative database from healthy volunteers (perimetry normative build). The portal exports the candidate exams (schema perimetry-cohort/1); every inclusion/exclusion rule and every statistic is applied here, in /core, never in the portal. Padrão proposto, aguardando confirmação do product owner (docs/CLINICAL_SPEC.md §8.1).

reliability._doc: When useAlertLimits is true an exam is excluded when any reliability rate exceeds the alert limits of reliability.json (FL > 20%, FP > 15%, FN > 33%), as the HFA normative studies did.

_learningDoc: excludeFirstExamPerEye drops each eye's first exam when that eye has a later eligible exam (learning effect: Heijl & Bengtsson 1996, Wild et al. 1989). oneExamPerEye = 'latest' keeps one exam per eye so the percentiles are not weighted by repeat examinations. Both eyes of a subject are allowed (as in visualFields); the eyes are treated as independent, which slightly underestimates between-subject variance.
_statusDoc: The database is MEASURED only with at least minEyesForMeasured eligible eyes; below that it is built (from 30 eyes) but stays PROVISIONAL and every report carries the warning with N.
_ageRangeDoc: An exam whose age lies more than ageRangeMarginYears outside the cohort's age range is analysed (the regression is extrapolated) with a warning.
